title: LG to showcase AI technologies at Spark 2026
description: LG will showcase its latest artificial intelligence technologies and business applications at LG Spark 2026, running Monday through Sept. 17 at LG Sciencepark in Magok, western Seoul. Launched in 2023, LG Spark combines technology events hosted across the group. This year’s program has been reorganized around five AI-focused events: the LG Tech Fair, LG AX Fair, AI Talk Concert, AI DevCon and Culture Week.
